# `company.sales_tax_payment_profiles`

Immutable one-to-one sales tax remittance headers naming the agency whose liability fell.

Database: `company`.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `revision_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1, unique with transaction_id + revision_id | — | transaction_revisions.id | Immutable revision owning this one-to-one remittance header. |
